tools.name: check_us_legality
tools.description: Check whether a robot model may lawfully be sold in the United States under the FCC's 2026 rule on covered robotics equipment. Returns grandfathered-authorized, blocked-pending-conditional-approval, or unknown, with a dated explanation. Use this before recommending or ordering any model for a US buy

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_buy_route · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_buy_route · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
